text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
One day while walking through the city, I 
saw a crowd gathered in front of a street 
monitor.

text_block_list.name: Street Monitor
text_block_list.text:
"Come on, let's dance together with 
Usapy!"

text_block_list.name: Bubble Gum Fellow
text_block_list.text:
Hop around and twirl and dance! Everyone's 
happy in Usapy World♪

text_block_list.name: Street Monitor
text_block_list.text:
"Super popular! The Usapy and Bubble Gum 
Fellow collaboration apparel goods are on 
sale now♪"
choice_data_list:
She's really doing a collab with 
Usapy...!!

text_block_list.text:
Indeed. She has achieved her dream in 
splendid fashion, sir.

text_block_list.name: Fenomeno
text_block_list.text:
She put in an incredible amount of effort 
toward achieving this collab with Usapy, 
after all.
choice_data_list:
Yeah. Oh right, you're roommates, aren't 
you?

Yeah. Oh right, you're roommates, aren't 
you?

text_block_list.name: Bubble Gum Fellow
text_block_list.text:
Sorry for making such a mess. I'll clean 
it up, just give me a sec...

text_block_list.name: Fenomeno
text_block_list.text:
Do not pay it any mind. I support your 
dream as well, Bubble-san! Please, make 
yourself comfortable.

text_block_list.name: Fenomeno
text_block_list.text:
Furthermore, if you get peckish, feel free 
to have some anpan whenever you like! 
Consider it a patrol provision from me!

text_block_list.name: Fenomeno
text_block_list.text:
Bubble-san's dream came true, and as 
someone who supported her, I am immensely 
proud, sir!

text_block_list.name: Fenomeno
text_block_list.text:
Oh, that reminds me. Bubble-san has a 
collab event with Usapy starting soon. 
Would you care to join me, if you'd like?

text_block_list.name: Bubble Gum Fellow
text_block_list.text:
Alright everyone! Is everybody standing in 
front of their favorite color wallpaper~?

text_block_list.name: Children
text_block_list.text: Yeeees!

text_block_list.name: Bubble Gum Fellow
text_block_list.text:
Great, Usapy and I are going to film 
everyone, so dance with all your energy, 
okay!

text_block_list.name: Usapy
text_block_list.text:
Thank you, Bubble-chan! Now then everyone, 
let's daaance♪

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
It looks like an event where they film the 
children to create a simple mosaic art 
piece.

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
In fact, on the event's online live 
stream, the mosaic art is already coming 
together. The comment section is bursting 
with excitement.

text_block_list.name: Bubble Gum Fellow
text_block_list.text:
Ta-daaa! The mosaic art everyone made 
together is complete!!

text_block_list.name: Children
text_block_list.text: Waaaah! It's Usapy—!!

text_block_list.name: Bubble Gum Fellow
text_block_list.text:
Did everyone watching the stream have fun 
too? My collab with Usapy is far from 
over! Keep cheering for us, okay!

text_block_list.name: Bubble Gum Fellow
text_block_list.text: Thanks for watching. See you next time!

text_block_list.name: Bubble Gum Fellow
text_block_list.text:
Fenomeno! Trainer! I saw you from the 
stage! Thank you!

text_block_list.name: Fenomeno
text_block_list.text:
That was an outstanding show, sir! The 
children were having a wonderful time too!

text_block_list.name: Fenomeno
text_block_list.text:
...However, why did you speak in English 
at the very end?

text_block_list.name: Bubble Gum Fellow
text_block_list.text:
Ah, that? I insisted they let me slip that 
in!

text_block_list.name: Bubble Gum Fellow
text_block_list.text:
That mosaic art video that got famous... 
It's actually been getting really popular 
overseas too.

text_block_list.name: Bubble Gum Fellow
text_block_list.text:
It was well-received because they found 
the concept interesting, but...

text_block_list.name: Bubble Gum Fellow
text_block_list.text:
Since we have the chance, I wanted people 
all over the world to get to know Usapy 
too! So—

text_block_list.name: Bubble Gum Fellow
text_block_list.text: I hereby declare!

text_block_list.name: Bubble Gum Fellow
text_block_list.text:
"I'm going to make Usapy a global 
superstar!"

text_block_list.name: Fenomeno
text_block_list.text:
Fufu, that certainly sounds like quite the 
challenging mission...

text_block_list.name: Fenomeno
text_block_list.text:
However, I believe that if it's you, 
Bubble-san, you can definitely achieve it, 
sir! You—always make me feel that way.

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
I agreed with Fenomeno. There was no 
logical basis for it... but if it's 
Bubblegum Fellow, she can do it. You just 
feel that way.
choice_data_list:
I'm looking forward to the global 
expansion!
Have you decided on an ultimate goal?
Have you decided on an ultimate goal?

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
I agreed with Fenomeno. There was no 
logical basis for it... but if it's 
Bubblegum Fellow, she can do it. You just 
feel that way.
choice_data_list:
I'm looking forward to the global 
expansion!
Have you decided on an ultimate goal?
Have you decided on an ultimate goal?

text_block_list.name: Bubble Gum Fellow
text_block_list.text:
You can count on it! I'm brainstorming all 
kinds of ideas right now♪

text_block_list.name: Bubble Gum Fellow
text_block_list.text:
Aah, I can't wait~ Bringing Usapy to 
everyone across the world!

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
No matter how astronomical the dream, she 
would make it happen. I found myself 
believing it without a doubt.

text_block_list.name: Bubble Gum Fellow
text_block_list.text: Nope, haven't decided!

text_block_list.name: Bubble Gum Fellow
text_block_list.text:
Once you go out into the world, you see 
brand new horizons. And when that happens, 
your dreams swell even bigger, I think.

text_block_list.name: Bubble Gum Fellow
text_block_list.text:
So I'm not putting an end line on my dream 
from the start. It's way more fun that 
way!
